lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਹੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tis jan balihaaree teraa daan sabhanee hai leetaa ||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to such a humble being. O Lord, You bless all with Your bountiful blessings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਭਾਣਾ ਤਾਂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau bhaanaa taa(n) tripat aghaae raam ||
lines.translation: When it pleases You, then I am satisfied and satiated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man theeaa tha(n)dhaa sabh trisan bujhaae raam ||
lines.translation: My mind is soothed and calmed, and all my thirst is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਚੂਕੀ ਡੰਝਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man theeaa tha(n)dhaa chookee da(n)jhaa paaiaa bahut khajaanaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is soothed and calmed, the burning has ceased, and I have found so many treasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਣ ਲਗੇ ਹੰਉ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikh sevak sabh bhu(n)chan lage ha(n)u satagur kai kurabaanaa ||
lines.translation: All the Sikhs and servants partake of them; I am a sacrifice to my True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਖਸਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau bhae khasam ra(n)g raate jam kee traas bujhaae ||
lines.translation: I have become fearless, imbued with the Love of my Lord Master, and I have shaken off the fear of death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas sadaa sa(n)g sevak teree bhagat kara(n)u liv laae ||3||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak, Your humble servant, lovingly embraces Your meditation; O Lord, be with me always. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਜੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooree aasaa jee manasaa mere raam ||
lines.translation: My hopes and desires have been fulfilled, O my Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਜੀਉ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi niragun jeeu sabh gun tere raam ||
lines.translation: I am worthless, without virtue; all virtues are Yours, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh gun tere thaakur mere kit mukh tudh saalaahee ||
lines.translation: All virtues are Yours, O my Lord and Master; with what mouth should I praise You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੀਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun avagun meraa kichh na beechaariaa bakhas leeaa khin maahee ||
lines.translation: You did not consider my merits and demerits; you forgave me in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਾਧਾਈ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh paaee vajee vaadhaaee vaaje anahad toore ||
lines.translation: I have obtained the nine treasures, congratulations are pouring in, and the unstruck melody resounds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਥੇ ਜੀ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak mai var ghar paaiaa mere laathe jee sagal visoore ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have found my Husband Lord within my own home, and all my anxiety is forgotten. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਣੇਦੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa sunedo kooR va(n)njan pavan jhulaariaa ||
lines.translation: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak suneear te paravaan jo sunede sach dhanee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa raam ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sahaj suhele jin har har rasanaa bhaniaa raam ||
lines.translation: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: se sahaj suhele gunah amole jagat udhaaran aae ||
lines.translation: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai bohith saagar prabh charanaa kete paar laghaae ||
lines.translation: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin ka(n)u kripaa karee merai thaakur tin kaa lekhaa na ganiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to render their account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tis ghol ghumaaee jin prabh sravanee suniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: loin loee dith piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
lines.translation: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆਂ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se akhaReeaa(n) bia(n)n jinee disa(n)do maa piree ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee har prabh dithaa tin kurabaane raam ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: se saachee daragah bhaane raam ||
lines.translation: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur maane se paradhaane har setee ra(n)g raate ||
lines.translation: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har rasahi aghaae sahaj samaae ghat ghat ramaeeaa jaate ||
lines.translation: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestial peace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee sajan sa(n)t se sukheee thaakur apane bhaane ||
lines.translation: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak jin har prabh dithaa tin kai sad kurabaane ||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)njee naam vihooneeaa ||
lines.translation: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saphal jana(n)m jai ghat vuthaa sach dhanee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾਂ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kha(n)neeai va(n)njaa(n) jin meraa har prabh deethaa raam ||
lines.translation: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan chaakh aghaane har har a(n)mrit meethaa raam ||
lines.translation: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, and are satiated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੂਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har manahi meethaa prabhoo toothaa amiu voothaa sukh bhae ||
lines.translation: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon them, and they are at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸਹ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh naas bharam binaas tan te jap jagadees eesah jai jae ||
lines.translation: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of the Lord of the World, their victory is celebrated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh rahat bikaar thaake pa(n)ch te sa(n)g tootaa ||
lines.translation: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off.
